qa_0107.rewritten: Did the incidence of cardiovascular interventional procedures, such as coronary artery stent placements or cardiac pacemaker implantations, decrease during the coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic?

qa_0108.original: What kind of person makes the best boss for kids' heart doctors?
qa_0108.rewritten: What are the optimal leadership qualities and professional characteristics of an effective supervisor or manager for pediatric cardiologists?

qa_0109.original: If I have heart failure, how likely am I to be able to talk to my doctor through video or phone instead of going in person?
qa_0109.rewritten: In patients diagnosed with heart failure, what is the prevalence or likelihood of utilizing telemedicine modalities, such as video consultations or telephone calls, for clinical interactions with healthcare providers instead of in-person visits?

qa_0110.original: Have more women been getting top research roles in heart studies over the years, and does having women lead these projects help bring in more diverse teams?
qa_0110.rewritten: Has there been an increase in the representation of female investigators in principal investigator roles within cardiovascular research over time, and does female leadership in these research projects correlate with greater diversity in research team composition?

qa_0111.original: Why are there still so few women helping to make the big heart health rules doctors follow?
qa_0111.rewritten: What factors contribute to the continued underrepresentation of women in the development of major cardiovascular health guidelines adhered to by physicians?

qa_0112.original: I've been feeling occasional dizziness and numbness in my limbs—could these be signs of blood vessel problems that might lead to heart or brain issues?
qa_0112.rewritten: I have been experiencing intermittent episodes of dizziness and paresthesia in my extremities; could these symptoms be indicative of underlying vascular pathology that may predispose to cardiovascular or cerebrovascular complications?

qa_0113.original: Can a tiny brain implant both deliver medicine right where it’s needed and also record brain signals at the same time?
qa_0113.rewritten: Is it feasible for a miniature intracerebral implant to simultaneously administer pharmacological agents locally at targeted neural sites and record electrophysiological brain signals concurrently?

qa_0114.original: Is it safe for me to just buy low-dose aspirin at the drugstore to prevent heart problems, or should I only take it if a doctor says so?
qa_0114.rewritten: Is it safe for an individual to self-administer low-dose acetylsalicylic acid (aspirin) obtained over-the-counter for the primary prevention of cardiovascular events, or should its use be initiated exclusively under medical supervision?

qa_0115.original: If I apply for a heart specialist training program through online interviews, will I end up training far away from where I live or have worked before?
qa_0115.rewritten: If an individual applies for a cardiology specialist training program through virtual interviews, is there a likelihood that the training location will be geographically distant from their current residence or previous places of employment?

qa_0116.original: How can having a digital copy of my heart help doctors figure out the best treatment just for me?
qa_0116.rewritten: In what ways can the utilization of a digital anatomical and functional model of the heart assist clinicians in determining the optimal personalized therapeutic strategy for an individual patient?

qa_0117.original: Why do people with heart failure often forget or stop taking their medicines, and what can help them keep up with their treatment?
qa_0117.rewritten: What are the factors contributing to medication non-adherence or discontinuation among patients with heart failure, and what interventions or strategies can improve adherence to prescribed pharmacological treatment regimens in this population?

qa_0118.original: I've noticed fewer women doctors in heart care—could social media help change that and make it easier for women to enter this field?
qa_0118.rewritten: What is the impact of social media platforms on increasing the representation and facilitating the entry of female physicians into the field of cardiovascular medicine?

qa_0119.original: Can pigs be used to study why some people get irregular heartbeats after heart surgery, instead of using dogs?
qa_0119.rewritten: Is the porcine model appropriate for investigating the pathophysiological mechanisms underlying postoperative cardiac arrhythmias in humans, as an alternative to the canine model?

qa_0120.original: Can my heart doctor really check if I’m okay just by talking on the phone, or do I still need to go in person sometimes?
qa_0120.rewritten: Is it clinically valid for a cardiologist to assess a patient's cardiovascular health status solely through telephonic consultation, or are in-person clinical evaluations still necessary at certain intervals?

qa_0121.original: If I work with heart procedures that use X-rays and want to have a baby, how can I protect myself and my future child from any risks?
qa_0121.rewritten: What protective measures and safety protocols should be implemented for healthcare professionals performing cardiac interventional procedures involving ionizing radiation to minimize occupational exposure risks to themselves and their future offspring during conception and pregnancy?

qa_0122.original: After having preeclampsia, do people from different races get the same chances to see a heart doctor or regular doctor afterward, or do things like money and education make a difference?
qa_0122.rewritten: Following a diagnosis of preeclampsia, do individuals of different racial or ethnic backgrounds have equivalent access to cardiology or primary care services, or do socioeconomic factors such as income and educational attainment influence disparities in healthcare utilization?

qa_0123.original: If my kid has a heart check-up over video, how do doctors decide if they really need to do an ultrasound test?
qa_0123.rewritten: In pediatric cardiology telemedicine consultations, what clinical criteria and decision-making processes do physicians use to determine the necessity of performing a transthoracic echocardiogram or other cardiac ultrasound imaging?

qa_0124.original: If I know more about the doctor I'm seeing, will I feel more comfortable and ask more questions during my visit?
qa_0124.rewritten: Does increased patient knowledge regarding the healthcare provider they are consulting correlate with enhanced patient comfort and increased frequency of patient-initiated inquiries during the clinical encounter?

qa_0125.original: If someone wants to become a heart rhythm specialist, how long do they usually need to train, and what kind of hands-on experience should they expect?
qa_0125.rewritten: What is the typical duration of postgraduate medical training required to become a cardiac electrophysiologist, and what types of clinical and procedural hands-on experience are generally involved in this subspecialty?

qa_0126.original: How do doctors learn to use heart MRI machines well enough to make sure the pictures are accurate and helpful?
qa_0126.rewritten: What educational methods and training protocols are employed to ensure physicians achieve proficiency in cardiovascular magnetic resonance imaging acquisition and interpretation, thereby guaranteeing image accuracy and clinical utility?

qa_0127.original: Could feeling stressed or isolated make it harder for me to keep my blood pressure under control if I have cancer?
qa_0127.rewritten: Can psychological stress or social isolation contribute to difficulties in maintaining blood pressure control in patients diagnosed with cancer?

qa_0128.original: Can I trust AI chatbots like ChatGPT to give me accurate answers about heart procedures based on the latest medical guidelines?
qa_0128.rewritten: To what extent can artificial intelligence conversational agents, such as Chat Generative Pre-trained Transformer, be relied upon to provide accurate and up-to-date information regarding cardiovascular interventional procedures in accordance with the most current clinical practice guidelines?

qa_0129.original: How do doctors keep the X-ray radiation as low as possible when fixing heart rhythm problems?
qa_0129.rewritten: What techniques and protocols do clinicians employ to minimize ionizing radiation exposure from fluoroscopic X-ray imaging during the management of cardiac arrhythmias?

qa_0130.original: How can I be sure that a pediatric heart doctor has the right experience to handle my child's specific heart condition?
qa_0130.rewritten: What criteria can be used to verify that a pediatric cardiologist possesses adequate clinical experience and expertise to manage my child's specific congenital or acquired cardiac condition?

qa_0131.original: Did fewer people going to the doctor for heart problems during COVID end up causing more heart-related deaths, especially at home?
qa_0131.rewritten: Did a reduction in healthcare utilization for cardiovascular complaints during the coronavirus disease 2019 pandemic result in an increase in cardiovascular mortality, particularly deaths occurring outside of hospital settings?

qa_0132.original: Can med students really get better at reading heart tests if they learn by doing and talking instead of just listening to a lecture?
qa_0132.rewritten: Does experiential learning combined with interactive discussion improve medical students' proficiency in interpreting cardiac diagnostic tests compared to traditional didactic lecture-based instruction?

qa_0133.original: If I’m undergoing cancer treatment and start feeling unusual tiredness, shortness of breath, or irregular heartbeats, could these be signs that my heart is being affected by the therapy?
qa_0133.rewritten: In patients undergoing oncologic treatment, do the onset of symptoms such as unusual fatigue, dyspnea, or cardiac arrhythmias indicate potential cardiotoxic effects of the therapy?

qa_0134.original: What are the best new ways doctors recommend managing long-term heart artery problems to keep things under control?
qa_0134.rewritten: What are the most effective contemporary clinical management strategies recommended by healthcare professionals for the long-term control of chronic coronary artery conditions?

qa_0135.original: If a heart doctor in training only sees a certain number of heart scans, can they still miss learning about some rare but serious heart problems?
qa_0135.rewritten: In cardiology fellowship training, does limited exposure to a finite number of cardiac imaging studies potentially result in failure to recognize or learn about rare but clinically significant cardiovascular pathologies?

qa_0136.original: If I come to the emergency room with chest pain, will the new guidelines mean I have to stay longer for tests before doctors can tell if it’s serious?
qa_0136.rewritten: In patients presenting to the emergency department with chest pain, do the updated clinical guidelines require an extended duration of observation and diagnostic testing before clinicians can determine the severity or clinical significance of the symptoms?

qa_0137.original: How do changes in tiny structures inside heart cells affect how adrenaline works and the heart’s electrical signals?
qa_0137.rewritten: How do alterations in subcellular microstructures within cardiomyocytes influence adrenergic signaling pathways and cardiac electrophysiological activity?

qa_0138.original: Can these deep-sea shrimp actually see the light they make inside their bodies?
qa_0138.rewritten: Are deep-sea shrimp capable of perceiving the bioluminescent light produced endogenously within their bodies?

qa_0139.original: If my doctor listens to my heart with an old-fashioned stethoscope, how can they tell if something is wrong without modern machines?
qa_0139.rewritten: How can a clinician detect abnormalities in cardiac function or pathology through auscultation using a traditional acoustic stethoscope without the assistance of advanced diagnostic imaging or electronic monitoring devices?

qa_0140.original: If I get a heart scan that shows no calcium buildup, does that mean I’m pretty safe from heart attacks for a long time?
qa_0140.rewritten: If a coronary artery calcium scan demonstrates no detectable coronary artery calcification, does this finding indicate a sustained low risk of myocardial infarction over an extended period?

qa_0141.original: Are transgender people more likely to have heart problems because of the hormones they take or because doctors don’t treat them well?
qa_0141.rewritten: Is there an increased incidence of cardiovascular complications among transgender individuals attributable to hormone replacement therapy, or is it related to disparities in healthcare provision and quality of medical treatment they receive?

qa_0142.original: If my child has a heart problem and feels tired or short of breath, how can heart MRI scans help doctors understand what’s wrong and decide the best treatment?
qa_0142.rewritten: In pediatric patients presenting with cardiac pathology accompanied by symptoms of fatigue and dyspnea, how can cardiovascular magnetic resonance imaging contribute to the assessment of cardiac function and structure, and assist clinicians in determining the optimal therapeutic management?

qa_0143.original: How can doctors make sure they're doing the best job when putting in and managing a heart pacemaker?
qa_0143.rewritten: What are the best practices and clinical guidelines for physicians to optimize the implantation and management of cardiac pacemakers?

qa_0144.original: Can these heart scans really help doctors find problems early and decide the best treatment for heart diseases?
qa_0144.rewritten: What is the diagnostic accuracy and clinical utility of cardiac imaging modalities in the early detection of cardiovascular abnormalities and in guiding optimal therapeutic decision-making for heart diseases?

qa_0145.original: If I have symptoms like shortness of breath and swelling in my legs, what new treatments should I ask my doctor about to better manage my heart condition?
qa_0145.rewritten: In patients presenting with dyspnea and peripheral edema, what novel therapeutic interventions should be discussed with a healthcare provider to optimize management of underlying cardiac pathology?

qa_0146.original: Are there big differences in how heart and lung surgery teams are set up at top hospitals, and does that affect how many surgeons or women work there?
qa_0146.rewritten: Are there significant differences in the organizational structure and composition of cardiothoracic surgery teams specializing in cardiac surgery versus pulmonary surgery at leading tertiary care hospitals, and do these differences influence the number of surgeons employed or the gender distribution, specifically the representation of female surgeons, within these teams?

qa_0147.original: If I join a heart study that looks at biomarkers, what are the chances it will actually help me or others like me?
qa_0147.rewritten: What is the likelihood that participation in a cardiovascular research study investigating biomarkers will provide clinical benefit to the participant or to other individuals with similar cardiovascular profiles?

qa_0148.original: ¿Por qué me siento tan cansado y sin energía si ya estoy recibiendo tratamiento para mi problema del corazón?
qa_0148.rewritten: ¿Cuáles son las causas de la fatiga persistente y la astenia en pacientes que están recibiendo tratamiento médico para una enfermedad cardíaca?

qa_0149.original: Can AI really help doctors catch heart problems earlier in people going through cancer treatment?
qa_0149.rewritten: Can artificial intelligence assist clinicians in the earlier detection of cardiovascular complications in patients undergoing oncological treatment?
